name: Retro 8-bit & Game
when_to_use: Gamification ('level up your workflow'), achievement unlocks, playful lists.

sounds.name: Arcade Power Up 01
sounds.desc: A punchy half-second arcade power-up with an instant attack; use for level-up or upgrade jokes.

sounds.name: Arcade Power Up 02
sounds.desc: A bright arcade power-up of just over half a second; use for an achievement unlock in a gamified edit.

sounds.name: Arcade Power Up 03
sounds.desc: A bright arcade power-up flourish of about 0.65 s; use for 'level up' or achievement moments.

sounds.name: Retro Confirm Jingle 01
sounds.desc: The loudest of the set, a wide-stereo multi-note retro jingle of about 0.9 s; use for a gamified 'level up' or achievement unlock.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Retro Confirm Jingle 02
sounds.desc: A short two-note retro game confirm whose second note peaks around 80 ms, ringing for about 0.7 s; use for achievement or game-reward moments.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Retro Confirm Jingle 03
sounds.desc: A wide-stereo two-note retro game confirm with about 0.7 s of ring; use for gamified achievement unlocks or playful success beats.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Retro Confirm Jingle 04
sounds.desc: A slightly darker wide-stereo two-note retro confirm with a 0.7 s ring; use for achievement or level-up style moments.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Retro Laser Pew 01
sounds.desc: A clean, unclipped quarter-second tonal arcade laser pew for a 'level up' or gamified list beat.

sounds.name: Retro Menu Click 01
sounds.desc: A short retro game-style select click of about a quarter second; use for playful menu selections or gamified lists.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Retro Menu Click 02
sounds.desc: A short retro game-style select click of about a quarter second, slightly softer onset; use for playful selections in a gamified sequence.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Retro Menu Tone 01
sounds.desc: A retro game-style tonal confirm with a half-second decay; use for playful menu selections or achievement-style list items.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Retro Menu Tone 02
sounds.desc: A slightly brighter retro game-style confirm tone with a 0.6 s decay; use for gamified selections and playful lists.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Arcade Power Up 04
sounds.desc: A bright 1.1 s arcade power-up that swells into its notes; use for level-up or achievement moments in a gamified edit.

sounds.name: Arcade Power Up 05
sounds.desc: A bright half-second arcade power-up flourish; use for a gamified upgrade or reward beat.

sounds.name: Arcade Power Up 06
sounds.desc: A short, very bright arcade power-up chirp; use for a quick game-style reward or coin-like moment.

sounds.name: Arcade Power Up 07
sounds.desc: A bright half-second arcade power-up that decays quickly; use for a gamified win or level-up beat.

sounds.name: High Sweep Down 01
sounds.desc: A half-second high synth tone sliding down in pitch, game-flavoured; use for a small element disappearing or a panel closing in playful edits.

sounds.name: High Sweep Up 01
sounds.desc: A half-second high synth tone sliding up in pitch; use when a text box, icon or card pops into frame in a lighter, playful edit.

sounds.name: Phaser Sweep Down 01
sounds.desc: A short phased synth tone sweeping down; use when a card or panel closes or slides away in a sci-fi or playful edit.

sounds.name: Phaser Sweep Down 02
sounds.desc: A half-second phased synth sweep down that sustains before fading; use for a panel collapsing or a card leaving frame.

sounds.name: Phaser Sweep Up 01
sounds.desc: A half-second phased synth tone sweeping up and holding; use when a panel or card opens or slides in on a sci-fi styled edit.

sounds.name: Phaser Sweep Up 02
sounds.desc: A half-second phased synth rise; use when a card, screenshot or panel animates onto the stage.

sounds.name: Three Tone Chime 01
sounds.desc: A clearer three-note synth tone sequence of under a second; use for a retro 'task complete' or notification moment.

sounds.name: Two Tone Chime 01
sounds.desc: A cleaner two-note synth tone cue of about 0.7 s; use for a retro confirm, success or new-message moment.
